h1: The 5 Best Privacy Screens for LG Monitors, Ranked & Reviewed
metaTitle: Best LG Monitor Privacy Screens: Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: 5 privacy screen filters for LG monitors in 21.5, 23.8 and 24 inch sizes, compared on fit, pack size and blue-light layer.
summary: The 23.8 inch 2-pack with blue-light filtering is the best privacy screen for most LG monitors, because it matches the panel size behind many LG 24 inch models. SightPro's single 23.8 inch filter is the budget alternative, the Peslv 24 inch 2-pack suits dual setups, and SightPro also covers 21.5 inch screens.
intro: Buying a privacy filter by the model name is how people end up with a filter that overhangs the bezel. LG sells many monitors as '24 inch' with a 23.8 inch panel, and a filter cut for 24 inches will not sit flush on one. Privacy filters work by narrowing the viewing angle, so a coworker beside you sees a dark screen. That only works if the filter covers the whole panel.

We ranked five privacy filters by size match, aspect ratio, pack size and extras. Fit is the whole job, so each pick is sorted by how well it matches a real LG panel size, and the ranking flags the odd cases such as 21.5 inch screens. The practical answer is to measure first, then match the pack to your setup.

products.name: 2-Pack 23.8 Inch Privacy Screen with Blue Light Filter
products.verdict: The most common LG panel size, in a 2-pack with blue-light filtering.
products.description:
This 2-pack fits 23.8 inch 16:9 monitors and adds blue-light filtering to the privacy layer. It sits in the $25 to $50 tier, with two filters in the box.

It tops the ranking because 23.8 inches is the real panel size behind many LG 24 inch models, and a filter sized to the panel avoids gaps at the bezel. The second filter is a practical bonus for a second monitor or a spare. SightPro offers a single 23.8 inch filter for less, but without the blue-light layer.

Buy it for a standard LG 24 inch monitor. Privacy filters darken the image a little and narrow the viewing angle, so raise brightness a notch, and confirm your panel's diagonal in the manual before ordering.
products.idealFor: Owners of 23.8 inch LG monitors who want a spare filter.
products.skipIf: Your panel is a different size.

products.name: SightPro 23.8 Inch 16:9 Privacy Screen Filter
products.verdict: A single 23.8 inch filter that matches the common LG panel size.
products.description:
SightPro's filter is cut for 23.8 inch 16:9 monitors and sold one to a pack, at a $25 to $50 price.

Second place comes from fit: it is right for the common LG panel, and one filter is all most people need for one screen. It gives up the second filter and the blue-light layer of the first-place pack.

Buy it for a single monitor on a shared or open-plan desk. The Peslv 24 inch is a different size, so do not swap them: a 24 inch filter on a 23.8 inch panel overhangs, and a short filter leaves the edge exposed.
products.idealFor: One 23.8 inch LG monitor on a shared desk.
products.skipIf: You want a spare or blue-light filtering.

products.name: Peslv 24 Inch Privacy Screen, 2-Pack
products.verdict: A removable 2-pack for standard 24 inch 16:9 flat monitors.
products.description:
Each Peslv box carries a matched pair of take-off filters made for flat 24 inch widescreens, priced $50 to $100.

It ranks third since 24 inches is a true panel size on some LG models, though not the most common. Removable filters let you take the screen off for presentations, and two of them cover a dual setup. It costs more than the SightPro singles in this guide.

Buy it for a two-monitor desk with 24 inch screens. If your LG is a 23.8 inch model, buy the 23.8 pack instead, because a mismatched filter leaves visible gaps.

products.name: SightPro 24 Inch 16:9 Privacy Screen Filter
products.verdict: A single 24 inch filter for one standard monitor.
products.description:
SightPro's 24 inch filter fits a single 16:9 monitor and is sold individually in the $25 to $50 tier. A true 24 inch panel is rarer than the marketing suggests, so many buyers will not need it.

It ranks fourth because it duplicates the 23.8 inch filter's role for a slightly bigger panel. Compared with the Peslv it is cheaper per filter but offers no second sheet. Peslv costs more but gives two filters and removability, which this single sheet lacks.

Buy it if your monitor is a true 24 inch panel. Measure the visible diagonal with a tape before ordering. If your tape reads 23.8 inches, choose the 23.8 filter instead.

products.name: SightPro 21.5 Inch 16:9 Privacy Screen Filter
products.verdict: A single filter for entry-level 21.5 inch LG monitors.
products.description:
SightPro's 21.5 inch 16:9 filter is a single unit in the $25 to $50 tier, aimed at entry-level 21.5 inch LG monitors. It is the only pick here for small panels, so its fit is worth more than its rank implies.

It lands fifth because it serves a narrower group than the 23.8 and 24 inch sizes. The fit is what you pay for, so a filter that matches the panel avoids bezel gaps.

Buy it for a small office or student monitor. Do not use it on a 22 inch 16:10 panel, which has a different shape.
products.idealFor: Small office or student 21.5 inch monitors.

whatMatters.detail: Panel diagonal is the corner-to-corner size of the visible picture. LG often markets a monitor as 24 inch while the panel is 23.8, and a filter cut a fraction larger overhangs the bezel while a smaller one leaves an exposed edge. Measure the visible screen with a tape, or read the spec sheet, then match it to the filter size.

Aspect ratio is the width-to-height shape of the screen. Most current LG monitors are 16:9, but some office and productivity panels are 16:10, taller by a strip. A 16:9 filter on a 16:10 panel leaves part of the screen uncovered. Check your resolution: 1920 by 1080 is 16:9, which is what every pick here is cut for.

Pack size decides cost per screen and what you do when a filter gets scratched. The 23.8 inch blue-light set and the Peslv 24 inch come as pairs, which covers a dual setup or a spare. SightPro sells singles. Count the monitors you actually use at that desk, and compare the price per filter, not the box.

A privacy filter dims the picture and narrows the viewing angle by design, because the louvers block light that leaves at wide angles. Expect slightly lower brightness and a warmer tone. Raise your monitor brightness a notch after fitting, and skip filters if color accuracy matters, since none of these listings promise color-critical output.

Removability is how the filter attaches and whether you can take it off again. Take-off filters suit presentations, shared desks and quick screen cleaning; permanent ones suit fixed desks. The Peslv pair is listed as removable. Read the attachment method on the page, and confirm adhesive strips will not mark your bezel.

faq.q: Will it fit my LG monitor?
faq.a: Match the panel diagonal first, then confirm 16:9. A 23.8 inch LG needs the 23.8 inch filter, from SightPro or the blue-light 2-pack, and a 21.5 inch LG needs the SightPro 21.5. Measure rather than trust the product name.

faq.q: What is the most common mistake?
faq.a: Ordering a 24 inch filter for a 23.8 inch panel because the monitor is sold as a 24 inch. The Peslv and SightPro 24 inch filters overhang a 23.8 inch screen, so check the actual diagonal in the manual before you pay.

faq.q: Is a privacy filter worth it over turning the screen?
faq.a: Yes, in an open office. A filter like SightPro's 23.8 inch hides the picture from anyone off to the side, which turning the screen cannot do in a row of desks. If you work alone in a closed room, the dimming is not worth it.

Clean the screen with a microfiber cloth, align one corner, then lay the filter across and smooth out bubbles. Do it in a dust-free room with the monitor off. The Peslv pair is removable, so you can reposition a crooked first attempt.

Wipe with a dry microfiber cloth and avoid sprays, which seep under the edge and cloud the filter. Store the spare from a 2-pack, such as the Peslv or the blue-light set, flat and out of sunlight so it does not warp.

Slightly. Any filter dims the image and narrows the viewing angle, so raise brightness a notch. The blue-light 2-pack adds a warmer tint on top of that. Do not use any of these for color-critical editing or print proofing.

finalTake: The 23.8 inch 2-pack with blue-light filtering is the privacy screen to buy for most LG desks, and the SightPro 23.8 inch is the budget single. Peslv covers dual 24 inch setups, and Vxaop is the only option for 16:10. Measure the panel first, because fit is everything.
